name: suggestarr-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is SuggestArr, a self-hosted media automation service: it reads what users
watch on Jellyfin, Plex or Emby, finds similar movies and TV shows through TMDB, and requests them on
Seer (Overseerr or Jellyseerr). Its Python backend, the Flask application in `api_service/`, serves the
web dashboard, an authenticated internal API under `/api/` and a public API under `/api/v1/`.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is SuggestArr's web and API platform: the modules api_service/app.py and api_service/frontend_routes.py, the packages api_service/auth/, api_service/api/, api_service/db/, api_service/config/, api_service/exceptions/ and api_service/utils/, and the blueprint packages api_service/blueprints/auth/, api_service/blueprints/users/, api_service/blueprints/health/, api_service/blueprints/tmdb/, api_service/blueprints/plex/, api_service/blueprints/jellyfin/ and api_service/blueprints/seer/, together with README.md, the pages docs/API.md, docs/TMDB_API_ENDPOINTS.md and docs/INSTALLATION.md, the OpenAPI description api_service/openapi/public-api-v1.yaml of the public API, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
